mapper.select: SELECT COUNT (1) FROM wms_transport t LEFT JOIN wms_storage_location t1 ON t.origin = t1.loc_no LEFT JOIN wms_roadway t2 ON t1.rela_roadway_id = t2.id WHERE destination = #{locationCode} AND state in ('executing', 'prepare' ,'dropFinish') AND (t2.is_enable = 0 or t2.is_enable is null)

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM wms_transport t LEFT JOIN wms_outbound t1 ON t.business_order_id = t1.id LEFT JOIN wms_storage_location t3 ON t.origin = t3.loc_no LEFT JOIN wms_roadway t2 ON t3.rela_roadway_id = t2.id WHERE destination =#{locationCode} and t1.exit_location =#{outStation} and t.state in ('executing', 'prepare' ,'dropFinish') and (t2.is_enable = 0 or t2.is_enable is null)

SELECT t.container_code, t1.external_no orderNo FROM wms_transport t LEFT JOIN wms_outbound t1 ON t.business_order_id = t1.id LEFT JOIN wms_storage_location t3 ON t.origin = t3.loc_no LEFT JOIN wms_roadway t2 ON t3.rela_roadway_id = t2.id WHERE destination = #{locationCode} AND t1.exit_location = #{outStation} AND t.state IN ('executing', 'prepare') AND (t2.is_enable = 0 OR t2.is_enable IS NULL)
select slide_code from wms_inventory_requisition_order where inner_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT t1.create_time waveLocalTime, t1.create_time waveTime, t1.inner_no orderNo FROM wms_pick_item t LEFT JOIN wms_inventory_requisition_order t1 ON t.business_id = t1.id WHERE t.container_code = #{containerCode} AND t.pick_station = #{pickStation} ORDER BY t1.create_time LIMIT 1
